scenes.vo: Tadao Ando fought as a pro boxer, and never went to architecture school. He taught himself from books.
His first big house? You cross an open courtyard to get to bed. Even in the rain.
Here, a glass wall slides away, so the service faces a lake.
And this museum is buried in a hill, lit only from above.

caption:
A former boxer with no degree became the master of concrete and light.

Tadao Ando taught himself architecture from books. Then he cut a cross into a wall and let the sun do the rest.
